description:
Hi! I’m a B.Tech Cybersecurity student interested in space exploration, technology, and creative problem-solving. Our team has chosen “Abandoned but not Forgotten,” focusing on storytelling about NASA’s discarded equipment on the Moon and Mars.

I’m looking for teammates interested in programming, web development, UI/UX design, data visualization, research, and space science. Let’s work together to turn space history into an engaging and meaningful experience!
